observations: macOS boot time and reboot history confirm a restart.
No panic report for this restart was found in the accessible standard diagnostic directories. DumpPanic logs say no SOCD data was found.

An earlier Coheryn disk-write diagnostic (ending 2026-10-30 22:04:39 +0600) recorded 34.36 GB cumulative writes, 532 MB free storage, and action taken: none. This is a resource diagnostic, not proof of a fatal crash.
Before restart, an earlier sample showed about 3.54 GiB occupied by compressed memory. This was system-wide, not Coheryn allocation alone.
No active Coheryn qualification/server/probe process was found after reboot. Current free storage is about 13 GiB.

After reboot, privileged pmset -g therm reported no recorded thermal or performance warning. This does not reconstruct pre-reboot temperatures.
assessment: The tests may have contributed to overall resource pressure or a freeze, but the available evidence does not establish the restart cause.
